name: json.format
description: Parses a JSON string and re-encodes it as readable formatted JSON using Real's JSON parser and encoder.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: JSON string to parse before formatting.

parameters.name: encodeOptions
parameters.description: Optional encode options passed to the re-encode step. Pretty output is forced on.

parameters.name: decodeOptions
parameters.description: Optional decode options used while parsing the input.
